summary.text: Lee James is a Republican state representative from Venango County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 64 since being first elected in 2012 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is the Republican chairman of the House Labor and Industry Committee.

paragraphs.text: James served in the U.S. Navy from 1966 to 1972.
According to Ballotpedia he earned a B.S. in economics from Clarion University in 1974 and an MBA from Clarion in 1983.
His official biography says he has more than 40 years of experience in the banking and investment management sectors.

James serves on or has served on the boards of a number of local organizations, including the Venango College campus advisory board, the French Creek Council of the Boy Scouts of America and the Venango County Blind Association.

As a legislator he was appointed Republican chairman of the House Labor and Industry Committee for the 2025-26 session, and his biography lists his priorities as streamlining regulations, infrastructure, responsible use of natural resources and education.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Amanda Shaffer as his opponent in the general election.
